=== PASSAGE 1: WEB PAGE ===
Harlow Insurance — Roadside Assistance Add-Ons

Add roadside assistance to any Harlow auto policy and drive with confidence. Choose the level of coverage that fits your needs:

Basic — $4 per month
Towing up to 15 miles, battery jump-starts, and flat-tire changes

Plus — $7 per month
Everything in Basic, with towing extended to 50 miles, plus fuel delivery and lockout service

Premier — $11 per month
Everything in Plus, with towing up to 100 miles and reimbursement of up to $300 for hotel stays when a breakdown occurs more than 100 miles from home

Plans may be added or upgraded at any time by contacting your agent. However, coverage under any new or upgraded plan begins 14 days after the change is requested. Requests to downgrade take effect at the start of the following billing month.

===
=== PASSAGE 2: E-MAIL ===
To: Denise Castellano <dcastellano@harlowins.com>
From: Arturo Benítez <abenitez@quickpost.net>
Date: July 2
Subject: My policy

Dear Ms. Castellano,

Last Saturday, my car's battery died in the parking lot of a shopping center about 20 miles from my home. A tow truck sent by Harlow arrived within 40 minutes, and the driver was able to get the car started on the spot, so no tow was needed. I was very impressed with the service.

That experience has made me think about the long trip my family is taking in August, when we will drive roughly 600 miles to visit relatives. I would like to switch to the plan that covers lodging in case something goes wrong on the road. Since we leave on August 9, I assume there is plenty of time for the new coverage to begin before then.

Also, my daughter will be borrowing the car regularly while she is home from university this summer. Could you tell me whether she needs to be added to the policy as a driver?

Best regards,
Arturo Benítez

questions.q: According to the web page, what is true about changes to roadside assistance plans?
options: Upgrades take effect only after a waiting period.
Downgrades are not permitted during the first year.
Changes must be requested through the Web site.
A processing fee is charged for each change.
questions.evidence: coverage under any new or upgraded plan begins 14 days after the change is requested
questions.explain: Đoạn cuối trang web: quyền lợi của gói mới hoặc gói nâng cấp chỉ bắt đầu 14 ngày sau khi yêu cầu → nâng cấp có hiệu lực sau một thời gian chờ (A). (B) sai: hạ cấp được phép, có hiệu lực từ đầu kỳ thanh toán tháng sau. (C) sai: thay đổi bằng cách liên hệ đại lý ("contacting your agent"). (D) không nhắc phí xử lý.

questions.q: What does Mr. Benítez indicate about his recent experience?
options: He had to wait more than an hour for help.
The problem was fixed where his car was parked.
His car was towed to a repair shop near his home.
He was charged for a service his plan did not include.
questions.evidence: the driver was able to get the car started on the spot, so no tow was needed
questions.explain: Ông Benítez kể tài xế xe cứu hộ đã khởi động được xe "on the spot" (ngay tại chỗ), không cần kéo xe → sự cố được giải quyết ngay tại bãi đỗ (B). (A) sai: xe cứu hộ đến trong vòng 40 phút. (C) sai: "no tow was needed". (D) không có thông tin; ông còn rất hài lòng với dịch vụ.

questions.q: How much will Mr. Benítez most likely pay per month for the plan he wants?
questions.evidence: reimbursement of up to $300 for hotel stays when a breakdown occurs more than 100 miles from home
questions.explain: Email: ông muốn chuyển sang gói "covers lodging" (chi trả chỗ ở). Trang web: chỉ gói Premier có hoàn tiền khách sạn tới $300 → giá $11/tháng (C). (A) $4 là gói Basic, (B) $7 là gói Plus — đều không có chi phí khách sạn. (D) $15 = $4 + $11, cộng nhầm hai gói.

questions.q: What is suggested about Mr. Benítez's request to change plans?
options: It will take effect at the start of the next billing month.
It must be approved by a different agent.
It cannot be processed because of his recent service call.
The new coverage will be active before his trip begins.
questions.evidence: Since we leave on August 9, I assume there is plenty of time for the new coverage to begin before then.
questions.explain: Email gửi ngày 2/7, chuyến đi bắt đầu 9/8. Trang web: gói nâng cấp có hiệu lực 14 ngày sau yêu cầu → khoảng 16/7, trước chuyến đi → giả định của ông là đúng (D). (A) sai: "đầu kỳ thanh toán tháng sau" áp dụng cho HẠ cấp, còn ông nâng cấp lên Premier. (B), (C) không có căn cứ.

questions.q: What does Mr. Benítez ask Ms. Castellano about?
options: Whether a family member must be listed on his policy
How to file a claim for a recent repair
When his next monthly payment is due
Whether students qualify for a discount
questions.evidence: Could you tell me whether she needs to be added to the policy as a driver?
questions.explain: Đoạn cuối: ông hỏi con gái (sẽ mượn xe thường xuyên trong hè) có cần được thêm vào hợp đồng với tư cách người lái không → hỏi một thành viên gia đình có phải ghi tên vào hợp đồng không (A). (B) sai: không có yêu cầu bồi thường sửa chữa. (C) không nhắc. (D) bẫy từ "university" — ông không hỏi về giảm giá cho sinh viên.

=== PASSAGE 1: JOB POSTING ===
Lakeview Medical Center — Patient Access Supervisor (Full-Time)

Lakeview Medical Center is seeking an experienced supervisor to oversee the admissions and registration team at our main campus. The successful candidate will manage a staff of twelve, coordinate shift schedules, and ensure that patient records are completed accurately and in compliance with hospital policy.

Requirements:
• At least three years of experience in hospital registration, admissions, or a related field

• Familiarity with medical insurance verification procedures

Applications received by March 14 will be given priority. Selected candidates will be invited to interview in person with a panel consisting of the Director of Patient Services, the Human Resources Manager, and a current admissions team member.

Rebecca Lindgren

Tuesday, March 27 | 2:00 P.M. | D. Whitfield, R. Lindgren, J. Marsh

Khả năng nói tiếng Tây Ban Nha hoặc tiếng Việt chỉ nằm ở mục "Preferred" (ưu tiên), không phải yêu cầu bắt buộc → D. Bẫy: người đọc lướt dễ gộp mục ưu tiên vào yêu cầu.

questions.q: What is suggested about Ms. Okoye?
options: She has one of the qualifications the hospital prefers.
She submitted her application before March 14.

She has less experience than the position requires.

Email (bài 2): chọn những buổi đó thì sau đó giám đốc sẽ liên hệ riêng để gọi điện ngắn → bà sẽ nói chuyện điện thoại với giám đốc sau (C). (A), (D) không được yêu cầu. (A), (B), (C) đều không được nhắc. Bẫy: (B) "application form" liên tưởng đến việc ứng tuyển nhưng hồ sơ đã nộp rồi.

=== PASSAGE 1: WEB PAGE ===
Ridgeback Coffee Roasting Co. — Wholesale Program

Ridgeback supplies freshly roasted coffee to cafés, restaurants, and offices throughout the Pacific Northwest. Wholesale prices are based on the total weight of each order:

Order size | Price per kilogram
5–19 kg | $24.00
20–49 kg | $21.50
50 kg or more | $19.00

• Orders placed by noon on Monday are roasted on Tuesday and delivered on Wednesday or Thursday.
• Delivery is free for orders of 20 kg or more within 40 miles of our roastery in Tacoma. A $25 delivery fee applies to all other orders.
• New wholesale accounts receive one complimentary on-site barista training session.
• Decaffeinated versions of our coffees are available for an additional $2.00 per kilogram.

===
=== PASSAGE 2: ORDER FORM ===
Ridgeback Coffee Roasting Co. — Wholesale Order Form
Account: Bluebird Café (Olympia, WA — 32 miles from roastery)
Order placed: Monday, October 6, 10:15 A.M.

Product | Quantity
Harbor House Blend | 12 kg
Summit Dark Roast | 6 kg
Summit Dark Roast (decaffeinated) | 4 kg

Special instructions: Please deliver to the rear entrance before 7:00 A.M. if possible.

===
=== PASSAGE 3: E-MAIL ===
To: orders@ridgebackcoffee.com
From: Jamal Whitcombe <jamal@bluebirdcafe.com>
Date: October 8
Subject: Today's delivery

Hello,

Our order arrived this morning, and everything looked fine except that the 4 kg of Summit Dark Roast that should have been decaffeinated were regular. Because we have only a small amount of decaf left, I would like the correct coffee sent as soon as possible. We are happy to keep the regular Summit beans and be billed for them, since our customers go through them quickly anyway.

Also, I noticed that your invoice includes a $25 delivery fee. I believe this was charged in error, given the size of our order and our location.

Finally, our second location, in Lacey, is opening next month, so I expect our weekly orders to at least double. Could someone let me know whether deliveries to that address would also be free?

Jamal Whitcombe

questions.q: According to the web page, what is true about Ridgeback's wholesale program?
options: Orders are delivered on the same day they are roasted.
Customers pay less per kilogram when they order more.
Delivery is free for every customer located in Tacoma.
Barista training is offered monthly to all accounts.
questions.evidence: Wholesale prices are based on the total weight of each order:
questions.explain: Bảng giá: 5–19 kg là $24, 20–49 kg là $21.50, từ 50 kg là $19 → đặt càng nhiều thì giá mỗi kg càng thấp (B). (A) sai: rang thứ Ba, giao thứ Tư hoặc thứ Năm. (C) sai: miễn phí giao hàng cần ĐỒNG THỜI từ 20 kg trở lên và trong bán kính 40 dặm. (D) sai: chỉ tài khoản MỚI được MỘT buổi đào tạo miễn phí.

questions.q: What price per kilogram applies to the Harbor House Blend in Bluebird Café's order?
questions.evidence: Harbor House Blend | 12 kg
questions.explain: Giá dựa trên TỔNG trọng lượng đơn hàng (bài 1). Phiếu đặt hàng (bài 2): 12 + 6 + 4 = 22 kg → thuộc mức 20–49 kg, giá $21.50/kg (C). Bẫy (A) $24: tính riêng 12 kg của Harbor House. (B) $23.50 là giá loại decaf ($21.50 + $2), không áp dụng cho Harbor House. (D) $19 cần từ 50 kg.

questions.q: Why does Mr. Whitcombe believe the delivery fee was charged in error?
options: His café is located in Tacoma.
He has been a customer of Ridgeback for many years.
He asked for the order to arrive before 7:00 A.M.
His order was large enough and his café is close enough.
questions.evidence: Delivery is free for orders of 20 kg or more within 40 miles of our roastery in Tacoma.
questions.explain: Kết nối 3 bài: email nói phí $25 bị tính nhầm "given the size of our order and our location"; phiếu đặt hàng cho thấy đơn 22 kg và quán ở Olympia, cách xưởng 32 dặm; trang web miễn phí giao cho đơn từ 20 kg trong vòng 40 dặm → đơn đủ lớn và quán đủ gần (D). (A) sai: quán ở Olympia. (B) không có thông tin. (C) giao trước 7 giờ chỉ là yêu cầu đặc biệt, không liên quan phí.

questions.q: What does Mr. Whitcombe indicate about the regular Summit Dark Roast that was delivered by mistake?
options: He is willing to keep it and pay for it.
He will send it back with the next delivery.
It was damaged during shipping.
It was roasted earlier than he expected.
questions.evidence: We are happy to keep the regular Summit beans and be billed for them, since our customers go through them quickly anyway.
questions.explain: Đoạn 1 email: quán sẵn sàng giữ lại 4 kg Summit loại thường và chịu tính tiền ("be billed for them") vì khách dùng hết nhanh → (A). (B) trái với việc giữ lại hàng. (C) sai: "everything looked fine" ngoài lỗi sai loại. (D) không có thông tin về thời điểm rang.

questions.q: What is suggested about Bluebird Café's October 6 order?
options: It was the café's first order with Ridgeback.
It was placed early enough to be roasted the next day.
It arrived later than the roaster's stated schedule.
It qualified for Ridgeback's lowest price level.
questions.evidence: Orders placed by noon on Monday are roasted on Tuesday and delivered on Wednesday or Thursday.
questions.explain: Phiếu đặt hàng: đặt lúc 10:15 sáng thứ Hai 6/10 — trước hạn trưa thứ Hai (bài 1) → được rang vào thứ Ba, tức ngày hôm sau (B). (A) không xác định được. (C) sai: hàng đến ngày 8/10 (thứ Tư), đúng lịch. (D) sai: 22 kg chỉ ở mức 20–49 kg; mức thấp nhất cần từ 50 kg.

=== PASSAGE 1: NOTICE ===
City of Marlow — Call for Mural Proposals

The Marlow City Council, in partnership with the Delacroix Art Gallery, invites artists to submit proposals for three new public murals to be painted this summer. The selected designs will be painted on the following walls:

Site A: Eastside Bus Terminal, north wall (12 m × 4 m)
Site B: Marlow Public Library, parking garage entrance (8 m × 3 m)
Site C: Riverside Community Center, gymnasium wall facing Pine Street (15 m × 6 m)

Artists selected will receive a commission of $8,000 for Site B, $12,000 for Site A, or $18,000 for Site C. All paint and equipment will be provided by the city. Designs should reflect the history or character of the surrounding neighborhood.

Artists may submit proposals for no more than two sites. Each proposal must include a color sketch, a short written description of the design, and photographs of at least three previously completed works. Artists who have not previously completed an outdoor mural must partner with an experienced muralist. Proposals must be received by the Delacroix Art Gallery by April 30. Finalists will be notified on May 20 and will present their designs at the City Council's public meeting on June 3.

===
=== PASSAGE 2: FORM ===
Mural Proposal Submission Form
Name: Yuna Takeda
Site(s) applied for: Site A, Site C
Design title(s): "The Last Ferry" (Site A); "Riverside Rhythms" (Site C)
Outdoor mural experience: None — collaborating with Owen Pritchard (completed murals in Dalton and Hayes City)
Date submitted: April 28
Attached: color sketches (2), design descriptions (2), photographs of previous works (4)

Comments: "The Last Ferry" shows the passenger ferry that carried workers across the river before the Eastside bridge was built in 1958. I am currently studying photographs from that period in the city archives to make the details as accurate as possible.

===
=== PASSAGE 3: E-MAIL ===
To: Yuna Takeda <ytakeda@artmail.com>
From: Lorraine Beck <lbeck@delacroixgallery.org>
Date: May 20
Subject: Mural proposals

Dear Ms. Takeda,

I am pleased to let you know that the selection committee has chosen your design for the Eastside Bus Terminal as one of three finalists for that site. Committee members were particularly impressed by the historical research behind your proposal. Unfortunately, your proposal for the community center was not selected.

As a finalist, you will be asked to give a ten-minute presentation of your design at the upcoming council meeting, and Mr. Pritchard is welcome to join you. Please also bring a revised sketch reflecting one change requested by the committee: the city's maintenance department has asked that the bottom meter of the wall be left unpainted because that area is cleaned frequently.

Best regards,
Lorraine Beck
Exhibitions Coordinator, Delacroix Art Gallery

questions.q: According to the notice, what is NOT required in each proposal?

Photographs of earlier projects

A written explanation of the design

questions.explain: Đoạn 4 thông báo: mỗi đề xuất phải có bản phác thảo màu (A), mô tả ngắn bằng văn bản (D) và ảnh của ít nhất ba tác phẩm đã hoàn thành (B). Không yêu cầu dự toán chi phí vật liệu — thậm chí sơn và dụng cụ do thành phố cung cấp ("All paint and equipment will be provided by the city") → C.

questions.q: Why did Ms. Takeda most likely list Mr. Pritchard on the form?
options: She was required to work with an experienced partner.
He is a member of the selection committee.
He provided her with photographs from the city archives.
He will paint the mural at Site C by himself.
questions.evidence: Artists who have not previously completed an outdoor mural must partner with an experienced muralist.
questions.explain: Đơn (bài 2) ghi bà Takeda chưa từng vẽ tranh tường ngoài trời ("None") và hợp tác với Owen Pritchard, người đã hoàn thành tranh tường ở Dalton và Hayes City. Thông báo (bài 1) quy định nghệ sĩ chưa có kinh nghiệm phải hợp tác với họa sĩ tranh tường có kinh nghiệm → (A). (B), (C), (D) không có căn cứ; bà tự nghiên cứu ảnh lưu trữ.

questions.q: How much will Ms. Takeda receive if her design is ultimately selected?
questions.evidence: Artists selected will receive a commission of $8,000 for Site B, $12,000 for Site A, or $18,000 for Site C.
questions.explain: Email (bài 3): thiết kế lọt vào chung kết là thiết kế cho Eastside Bus Terminal; thông báo (bài 1): Eastside Bus Terminal là Site A, thù lao $12,000 (B). (A) $8,000 là Site B (thư viện). (C) $18,000 là Site C — đề xuất cho trung tâm cộng đồng đã bị loại. (D) $30,000 = A + C, bẫy cộng cả hai đề xuất.

questions.q: When will Ms. Takeda most likely give her presentation?
options: On April 28
On April 30
On May 20
On June 3
questions.evidence: Finalists will be notified on May 20 and will present their designs at the City Council's public meeting on June 3.
questions.explain: Email chỉ nói bà sẽ thuyết trình "at the upcoming council meeting" mà không ghi ngày; thông báo (bài 1) cho biết các ứng viên chung kết trình bày tại cuộc họp công khai của Hội đồng ngày 3/6 (D). (A) 28/4 là ngày bà nộp đơn. (B) 30/4 là hạn nộp. (C) 20/5 là ngày báo kết quả (cũng là ngày gửi email).

questions.q: What did the selection committee most likely value in Ms. Takeda's proposal?
options: Her use of material from city records
Her experience painting murals in other cities
The large size of her planned design
Her plan to complete the work at a low cost
questions.evidence: I am currently studying photographs from that period in the city archives to make the details as accurate as possible.
questions.explain: Email: hội đồng đặc biệt ấn tượng với "the historical research behind your proposal"; đơn (bài 2): bà đang nghiên cứu ảnh thời kỳ đó trong kho lưu trữ của thành phố để chi tiết chính xác → hội đồng đánh giá cao việc dùng tư liệu từ hồ sơ lưu trữ thành phố (A). (B) sai: kinh nghiệm ở thành phố khác là của ông Pritchard; bà chưa từng vẽ ngoài trời. (C), (D) không được nhắc.
